summary:
ADR-0098 (docs/adr/0098-shared-algorithms-library-and-product-knowledge-pack.md) decides the ALGO-01 algorithms capability (Outcome FS-GG/.github#5222, Delivery #5223). The ADR is canonical; this record is a pointer and retrieval aid. Read the ADR's Status line for its current state.

- Producer: a new leaf public repository FS-GG/FS.GG.Algorithms (FSharp.Core only; any FS-GG repository may depend on it, it depends on none), so coordination code never depends on a game package and Rendering does not cycle with Game.
- Game.Core stays the implementation of record for the grid, collision, procedural and simulation algorithms it already ships. The pack indexes them in place, and a kernel moves only on demand, with Game.Core delegating and its fixtures unchanged.
- Packages: FS.GG.Algorithms (Fable required; graded LockstepExact or Portable) and FS.GG.Algorithms.Skills; FS.GG.Algorithms.Solvers is reserved for .NET-only solvers. Namespaces are FS.GG.Algorithms.<Family> over the 17-family taxonomy adopted from Root's prior-art survey. Layer 0 is a Fable-portable heap, onto which Game.Core's A* frontier migrates, and Q16.16 fixed-point.
- Admission: FsCheck properties against an independent oracle, a Fable proof, and kernel timings on two runtimes in the owning repository's bench/ folder (BenchmarkDotNet on .NET, a minimal Node harness for Fable-compiled kernels). Each run is admitted by the quiet-host capacity probe, and baselines are committed as JSON. Work counts may gate; timings never do. The FS.GG.Game #761/#792 harness is rendering-only. Porting external code follows the ADR's licence rules: implement from the paper by default; Stockfish and other GPL code are never ported.
- Pack: the product skill fs-gg-algorithms carries pack/, an unmodified fsgg.atlas/1 archive with one record per technique, ids algorithms/<family>/<technique>, fixed summary headings, and audience, determinism-grade and status tags. External literature goes under References, never copied; citations name FS-GG implementations. Private-repository content follows Root's #5223 ruling: clean re-implementation, no game data. Retrieval uses the atlas driver's atlas.py with --archive .agents/skills/fs-gg-algorithms/pack.
- Distribution: the owner-package route (schema-v2 multi-file manifest, SDD embed via the Rendering/Audio planner), with the predicate profile in [game, sample-pack] or template == fable-game. Upgrade must replace pristine owner-sourced skill files as one directory unit (an SDD change); edited files keep the drift advisory.
- Existing skills: fs-gg-grids, -collision, -line-drawing and -visibility get one owner, FS.GG.Game, and Rendering's copies retire (the Rendering owner must confirm). They are indexed, not folded. Measured on 2026-11-01: fable-game scaffolds received only collision, because the other three predicates lack template == fable-game.
- Growth loop: a capture rule at framework Delivery closure, plus an issue-form contribution route for workspaces. Framework-only algorithms (claim arbitration, CAS, publication lock) stay in the framework Atlas.

Retrieve the ADR for the taxonomy, the ranked seed list (foundations, harvest, then new items) and the open questions. Live delivery requires each owner's release and installed readback; this record grants none.
title: Shared algorithms library and product knowledge pack (ADR-0098)
